'''Force Sphere''' was a [[Force power/Legends|Force power]] used by the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]]. It created a sphere of [[Color/Legends|red]] energy that could both harm opponents and deflect [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] fire.<ref name="Jedi Power Battles">[[Star Wars: Episode I Jedi Power Battles|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''Jedi Power Battles'']]</ref>
